summary: Sell half of NVDA if it drops at least 0.2% from the last close during a market closure, with added safeguards.

checks.label: Market is closed
checks.why: Evaluate this protection during a closed US market stretch.

checks.label: Drop from last close
checks.why: Trigger when NVDA is down at least 0.2% from the last US close.

checks.label: Normal range filter
checks.why: This helps avoid selling on ordinary daily price wobble.

checks.label: Limit price impact
checks.why: This added limit helps prevent a sale with more than 1% price impact.

checks.label: Prevent repeat sale
checks.why: This added check prevents another sale during the same closed stretch.

assumptions: The normal-range threshold of 1 and the 1% price-impact limit are Talos-added defaults.
